title: Lotto
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office deals with the aftermath of the warehouse crew winning the lottery and quitting, leading to challenges in hiring new workers and managing warehouse duties. Meanwhile, the office rescues a dog left in a hot car, and Jim and Pam fantasize about what they would do with lottery money. Tensions rise as Darryl demands a managerial position or to be fired, and the team experiments with a new device called Señor Loadenstein while struggling with warehouse logistics.

main_threads.thread: The warehouse crew wins the lottery and quits, causing disruption and a scramble to hire new workers, with Darryl and Andy managing the difficult hiring process and warehouse challenges.
